clips.title: The story
paras: The Marshlands is a sprawling, sodden marsh occupying the southeastern reach of Un'Goro Crater. Sitting directly at the base of the winding ramp down from Tanaris, it is often the first wilderness newcomers witness upon entering the primeval basin.

Descending the steep trail from the arid expanse of Tanaris brings travelers directly into the humid mire of the Marshlands. Navigating anywhere else along the sheer crater rim invites a lethal fall, making this treacherous swath of wetlands the primary threshold into Un'Goro. Dense canopies, standing water, and mud conceal abundant packs of fierce raptors, including venomous varieties that stalk the reeds. Amid the damp clearings, explorers can find Blue Power Crystals scattered across the earth, unique to this quarter of the crater.

Despite the constant danger of predators, several solitary wilderness experts maintain outposts across the marsh. Perched upon a prominent earthen mound, the tauren hunter Torwa Pathfinder keeps watch over the primeval fauna. Across the wetlands, the troll Mor'vek studies and trains native ravasaurs.
